about: Datvest is the investment management arm of CBZ Holdings, serving individuals, corporates, pension funds, institutions and high-net-worth clients. It runs unit trusts, wealth and portfolio management, pension fund management, treasury bills and bonds, equity and money-market investments, and alternative investments, focused on capital preservation, growth and risk-adjusted returns.

faq.a: A pooled fund. Your money is combined with other investors' and managed by Datvest, and you own units whose value tracks the fund.
Yes. The value of investments can fall as well as rise, and past performance is not a guide to future returns.
Use Start investing, tell us your goal and timeframe, and an adviser sets out the options and opens your account.
